final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

###############################################################################
# Variables
###############################################################################

variable "vault_name" {
  description = "Name of the S3 Glacier archive vault. Allowed characters: a-z, 0-9, '-', '_' and '.' (max 255 characters)."
  type        = string
  default     = "glacier-archive-vault"

  validation {
    condition     = length(var.vault_name) <= 255 && can(regex("^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,254}$", var.vault_name))
    error_message = "The vault name must be 1-255 characters long and contain only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), hyphens (-), underscores (_) and dots (.)."
  }
}

variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name applied as a tag to all resources."
  type        = string
  default     = "production"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$", var.environment))
    error_message = "The environment name must be 1-64 characters using only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'."
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Data Sources
###############################################################################

# Resolves the current AWS account ID so the vault access policy can be
# restricted to principals within the same account (no hardcoded account IDs).
data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

# Vault access policy:
#   - Allow: least-privilege archive upload/retrieval workflow. The account
#     root principal delegates access to the IAM identities of the current
#     account; no cross-account access is granted.
#   - Deny: any Glacier request made over plain HTTP (aws:SecureTransport =
#     "false"), enforcing TLS for all vault API access.
#
# Resource ARNs are CONSTRUCTED from the region, the caller identity account
# ID and the deterministic (validated, no random suffix) vault name rather
# than referencing aws_glacier_vault.archive.arn. The vault consumes this
# document via its inline access_policy attribute, so referencing the vault
# resource here would create a Terraform dependency cycle. The constructed
# ARN scopes the policy to exactly this single vault with no loss of least
# privilege, and introduces no references to infrastructure outside this
# configuration.
data "aws_iam_policy_document" "archive" {
  statement {
    sid    = "AllowGlacierArchiveWorkflowFromAccount"
    effect = "Allow"

    actions = [
      # Single-request archive upload
      "glacier:UploadArchive",
      # Multipart upload (required for large archives)
      "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
      "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
      "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
      "glacier:ListParts",
      # Archive retrieval (inventory / archive jobs)
      "glacier:InitiateJob",
      "glacier:DescribeJob",
      "glacier:GetJobOutput",
      # Vault monitoring
      "glacier:DescribeVault",
      "glacier:ListJobs",
    ]

    resources = [local.vault_arn]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}:root"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "DenyInsecureTransport"
    effect = "Deny"

    actions   = ["glacier:*"]
    resources = [local.vault_arn]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["*"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "Bool"
      variable = "aws:SecureTransport"
      values   = ["false"]
    }
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Locals
###############################################################################

locals {
  # Deterministic vault ARN (region matches the provider block; the account ID
  # comes from the caller identity data source — nothing is hardcoded).
  vault_arn = "arn:aws:glacier:us-east-1:${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}:vaults/${var.vault_name}"

  common_tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
    ManagedBy   = "terraform"
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Glacier Vault
###############################################################################

resource "aws_glacier_vault" "archive" {
  name = var.vault_name

  # Vault access policy attached inline via the schema-supported access_policy
  # attribute (the standalone aws_glacier_vault_policy resource type is not
  # available in this provider schema). aws_glacier_vault_lock below references
  # the identical policy document, so the granted policy and the locked policy
  # always match exactly.
  access_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.archive.json

  tags = local.common_tags

  # The vault holds immutable archive data; accidental destruction must be blocked.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

###############################################################################
# Vault Lock
###############################################################################

resource "aws_glacier_vault_lock" "archive" {
  vault_name = aws_glacier_vault.archive.name
  policy     = data.aws_iam_policy_document.archive.json

  # complete_lock = false keeps the vault lock in the "InProgress" state so the
  # non-interactive automated apply stays recoverable and Terraform can keep
  # managing the policy. Setting complete_lock = true is IRREVERSIBLE and must
  # only ever be done deliberately by an operator.
  # NOTE: an InProgress lock auto-expires after 24 hours; Terraform will then
  # show the lock as needing recreation — this is expected, recoverable
  # behavior for an unattended apply.
  complete_lock = false
}

###############################################################################
# Outputs
###############################################################################

output "vault_name" {
  description = "Name of the S3 Glacier archive vault."
  value       = aws_glacier_vault.archive.name
}

output "vault_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the S3 Glacier archive vault."
  value       = aws_glacier_vault.archive.arn
}

output "vault_lock_policy" {
  description = "The locked Glacier vault access policy document (JSON)."
  value       = data.aws_iam_policy_document.archive.json
}
